cues.zh: 如果你连名字都不知道，想去调研某样东西就很难。
cues.en: It's difficult to research something if you don't know the name of it.

cues.zh: 几天前我收到一封邮件，问我能不能查到关于这个东西的信息。
cues.en: I got an email a few days ago asking if I could figure out anything about this.

cues.zh: 通常我是不太鼓励大家发这种消息的，
cues.en: And normally, I try to discourage messages like that,

cues.zh: 毕竟我不是 Google，也不是图书管理员，
cues.en: I'm not Google and I'm not a reference librarian,

cues.zh: 但这玩意儿彻底让我着迷了。
cues.en: but this thing completely nerd-sniped me.

cues.zh: 因为除了一条维基百科上的参考资料，
cues.en: Because other than one reference on Wikipedia

cues.zh: 提到了南安普顿水域上专门用于航运的这盏导航灯之外，
cues.en: to this exact light that's for shipping on Southampton Water,

cues.zh: 我什么都查不到。
cues.en: I couldn't find anything about it.

cues.zh: 这很奇怪，因为这个构思其实非常巧妙。
cues.en: Which is weird, because this is a really clever idea.

cues.zh: 这盏灯是基于莫尔条纹原理设计的，
cues.en: This light is based on moiré patterns,

cues.zh: 莫尔条纹就是当你把两个相似但略有不同的图案重叠在一起时，
cues.en: which are the extra lines and patches that seem to appear

cues.zh: 似乎额外浮现出来的线条和斑块。
cues.en: when you have two similar but slightly different patterns overlaid on each other.

cues.zh: 你在不少地方都能看到它们，但大多数时候它们都容易让人困惑、分心，
cues.en: You see them in a few places, but most of the time they're confusing and distracting

cues.zh: 设计师们巴不得避开它们。
cues.en: and designers want to avoid them.

cues.zh: 但这里的图案是这样设置的
cues.en: But here, the patterns are set up so that

cues.zh: 如果你正对着那盏灯，视线正对，你会看到平行线。
cues.en: if you're looking straight at that light, dead on, you see parallel lines.

cues.zh: 但如果你在任一侧，摩尔纹形成的箭头
cues.en: But if you're to either side, the arrows formed by the moiré patterns

cues.zh: 会告诉你该往哪个方向走才能正对它。
cues.en: tell you which way to go to be straight-on to it.

cues.zh: 你可以有五艘不同的船，在五个不同的位置，
cues.en: You can have five different boats in five different locations out there,

cues.zh: 全都看着同一个标志，而它们都会看到箭头
cues.en: all looking at the same sign, and they will all see arrows

cues.zh: 指向对它们来说正确的方向，不需要任何计算机或复杂的追踪。
cues.en: pointing the right way for them, without any computers or fancy tracking.

cues.zh: 这看起来是个绝妙的主意，我简直不敢相信它竟然不广为人知。
cues.en: This seems like such a good idea that I couldn't believe it wasn't well-known.

cues.zh: 于是我去搜索了。
cues.en: So I went searching.

cues.zh: “摩尔纹航运灯。”“摩尔纹船只灯。”
cues.en: "Moiré shipping light." "Moiré boat light."

cues.zh: 大约半小时后，我在英国各地找到了几个类似的，
cues.en: And after a half hour or so, I'd found a couple of others around the UK,

cues.zh: 安装在船闸和码头的入口处，
cues.en: placed at the entrances to locks and marinas,

cues.zh: 或者疏浚航道的尽头，这样驾驶船只的人
cues.en: or at the end of dredged channels, so that people steering a boat

cues.zh: 就能确切知道该往哪个方向走，避免撞到两侧。
cues.en: know exactly which way to go to avoid the sides.

cues.zh: 一本航海指南称之为“Inogen灯”
cues.en: One guide for mariners called it an "Inogen light"

cues.zh: 但这只把我引向一家医疗公司，别无其他。
cues.en: but that just led me to a medical company, nothing else.

cues.zh: 就这样。
cues.en: And that was it.

cues.zh: 它看起来像是一段奇特的航海史
cues.en: It looked like a bit of weird maritime history

cues.zh: 曾短暂风靡一时，随后便消失无踪，没留下任何痕迹。
cues.en: that had been a brief fad and then died out, leaving no trace.

cues.zh: 一个被世界忽视的绝妙想法。
cues.en: A beautiful idea that the world had ignored.

cues.zh: 我考虑开一个新的视频系列，叫“我不知道”
cues.en: I considered starting a new series of videos called "I Don’t Know"

cues.zh: 就是想看看有没有人了解更多，因为这实在太天才了
cues.en: just to see if anyone knew more about it, because it's genius

cues.zh: 而且，是的，我想弄明白它。
cues.en: and, yeah, I wanted to understand it.

cues.zh: 想得我脑子都停不下来，我不断回来，不断搜索。
cues.en: So much that my brain wasn't quite done, I kept coming back, I kept searching.

cues.zh: 最终，我开始翻查专利数据库。
cues.en: And eventually, I started looking through patent databases.

cues.zh: 几分钟后，我找到了。
cues.en: And after a few minutes, I found it.

cues.zh: 它由瑞典的Lars Bergkvist和Ivan Forsen于1970年代末申请了专利。
cues.en: It was patented by Lars Bergkvist and Ivan Forsen, from Sweden, in the late 1970s.

cues.zh: 他们两人各自发明了好几样与摩尔纹图案相关的东西。
cues.en: They'd invented several things to do with moiré patterns, between them.

cues.zh: 虽然第一项专利之后还有几项专利，
cues.en: And though there are a few more patents after the first,

cues.zh: 对想法做了改进，或者让它在二维平面上用圆圈实现，
cues.en: refining the idea or making it work in two dimensions with circles,

cues.zh: 但线索到那里就断了。
cues.en: the trail ended there.

cues.zh: 我试着追踪 Lars 或 Ivan 的下落，却找不到任何踪迹。
cues.en: I tried to track Lars or Ivan down, and couldn't find any trace.

cues.zh: 我手里只有大约四十年前的一个地址。
cues.en: The only thing I had was an address from about forty years ago.

cues.zh: 而且是在瑞典。
cues.en: And in Sweden.

cues.zh: 接着，一个被我眼角余光瞥见的小线索，解开了一切。
cues.en: And then one little clue, spotted just out the corner of my eye, unlocked everything.

cues.zh: 没错，这项专利是由 Bergkvist 和 Forsen 申请的，
cues.en: Yes, this was patented by Bergkvist and Forsen,

cues.zh: 但专利随后被转让给了一家叫 Inogon 的公司。
cues.en: but the patent was then assigned to a company called Inogon.

cues.zh: 不是 Inogen——那是个笔误，或者说是名字随时间发生的讹变。
cues.en: Not Inogen -- that was a typo, or a corruption of the name over time.

cues.zh: 是 Inogon。
cues.en: Inogon.

cues.zh: 这被称为 Inogon 导标，或者就叫 Inogon 灯。
cues.en: This is known as an Inogon leading mark, or just an Inogon light.

cues.zh: 一旦你知道这一点，一旦你叫出它的名字，你就能搜索到它。
cues.en: And once you know that, once you name it, you can search for it.

cues.zh: 你能找到 1986 年美国军方测试其有效性的分析报告。
cues.en: You can find the US military analysis from 1986 testing that it works.

cues.zh: 为了让飞机
cues.en: The variations that were made for getting an aircraft

cues.zh: 停靠到正确的机位上，他们做了一些改动。
cues.en: into the right place parking in a stand.

cues.zh: 现在生产这些灯的是瑞典公司FMT，
cues.en: The Swedish company called FMT that now makes them,

cues.zh: 或者说直到最近还在生产，因为他们刚把它从网站上撤掉了。
cues.en: or did until recently, because they've just removed it from their web site.

cues.zh: 一旦你知道这是Inogon灯，
cues.en: Once you know that this is an Inogon light,

cues.zh: 剩下的研究就都容易了。
cues.en: all the rest of the research becomes easy.

cues.zh: 除了一件事之外。
cues.en: All except one thing.

cues.zh: 这盏Inogon灯并不是用来引导人们进站的。
cues.en: This Inogon light isn't being used to guide people in.

cues.zh: 这盏灯沿着水下电缆的路径设置，而那里是不应该抛锚的。
cues.en: The light follows the path of an underwater cable where you shouldn't drop anchor.

cues.zh: 所以这里的信号完全不对。
cues.en: So the signal here is all wrong.

cues.zh: 你不想跟着这些箭头走，
cues.en: You don't want to follow these arrows,

cues.zh: 除非你是直接穿过，否则必须避开它们。
cues.en: you're required to stay away from them unless you're passing straight through.

cues.zh: 用这么昂贵的灯来做这种事，真的很奇怪。
cues.en: It's a really weird use for a very expensive light.

cues.zh: 那它为什么会在这里？
cues.en: So why is it here?

cues.zh: 我不知道。
cues.en: I don’t know.

cues.zh: 但如果外面有谁确实知道，且有证据……
cues.en: But if anyone out there does know, for sure, with evidence...

cues.zh: 请随时联系。
cues.en: do get in touch.
